# As-built architecture mapping `ABM`

[As built](../README.md) › As-built architecture mapping

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Reads a repository at a given commit and builds the as-built documentation of its structure: subsystems, capabilities, and file relationships, validated against real imports and definitions, then rendered as console pages and Markdown. Lets developers and reviewers see what the codebase actually looks like, including this map-generation system describing itself.

7 files, 6,927 lines.
